title: When To Solve, When To Verify: Compute-Optimal Problem Solving and Generative Verification for LLM Reasoning
authors_zh: Nishad Singhi、Hritik Bansal、Arian Hosseini、Aditya Grover、Kai-Wei Chang、Marcus Rohrbach、Anna Rohrbach（机构：达姆施塔特工业大学、hessian.AI、加州大学洛杉矶分校、Google DeepMind、Mila）
paper_type_zh: 面向求解与生成式验证的计算最优测试时扩展分析
best_for_zh: 为数学或科学推理设计验证器感知推理预算的读者。
one_line: The paper shows when solution sampling beats generative verification and fits scaling laws for allocating compute between them.
论文说明何时应扩大解答采样、何时应扩大生成式验证，并拟合二者的计算分配标度律。
why: It measures verification cost rather than treating a stronger verifier as free, yielding an actionable solve-versus-verify allocation rule.
inclusion_reason: It directly studies how a fixed inference budget should be divided between solution exploration and generative verification.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Extra inference computation can be spent in two different ways. Self-consistency samples many solutions and relies on answer frequency, increasing the chance that at least one reasoning path is correct. A generative reward model instead writes one or more verification chains for each candidate solution and uses its verdicts to rank candidates. Comparing the two at the same number of solutions makes verification appear efficient, but omits the substantial tokens required to generate the verification reasoning itself.

The paper asks what should happen under a fixed total compute budget: should a system generate more solutions, or should it generate fewer solutions and spend the saved computation checking them more carefully? It also asks how the optimal solution count and verification count scale as the budget grows. The relevant record is therefore not just an answer and a score; it includes each solution, each verification chain, its verdict probability, and the joint cost of producing all of them.

额外的推理计算可以有两种不同用途。自一致性会采样许多解答，并依靠答案出现频率作决定，从而增加至少有一条推理路径正确的机会。生成式奖励模型则为每个候选解答写出一条或多条验证链，并用其判决给候选排序。若只在相同解答数量下比较两者，验证似乎很高效；但这种比较遗漏了生成验证推理本身所需的大量令牌。

论文研究在固定总计算预算下系统应如何选择：是生成更多解答，还是生成较少解答并把节省的计算用于更仔细地检查它们？它还研究随着预算增加，最优的解答数量和验证数量应怎样扩展。因此，相关记录不只是答案和分数，还包括每条解答、每条验证链、其判决概率，以及生成所有这些内容的联合成本。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper evaluates solution sampling and generative verification on a compute-matched basis. For self-consistency, it samples S solutions and sets the number of verifications V to zero. For generative verification, it samples S solutions, produces V verification chains for every problem-solution pair, averages the verifier scores, and chooses the highest-scoring solution. The comparison therefore charges both generation and checking to the same budget instead of counting candidate solutions alone.

This exposes two regimes. At practical lower budgets, sampling additional solutions is generally more compute-efficient because verification chains can be as long as or longer than solutions. At sufficiently high budgets, a capable generative verifier can improve selection. The paper then fits separate power-law relations for optimal S and V, arguing that both should grow but solution generation should grow faster, by a reported factor of about 1.5 to 2 relative to verification.

论文在计算量匹配的基础上评估解答采样和生成式验证。对于自一致性，它采样 S 个解答并把验证数量 V 设为零；对于生成式验证，它采样 S 个解答，为每个问题—解答对生成 V 条验证链，平均验证器分数，再选择分数最高的解答。因此，这一比较把生成和检查都计入同一预算，而非只计算候选解答数量。

这揭示出两种区间。在实际常见的较低预算下，采样更多解答通常更具计算效率，因为验证链可能与解答一样长，甚至更长；在足够高的预算下，能力较强的生成式验证器能够改善选择。论文随后分别拟合最优 S 和 V 的幂律关系，认为二者都应增长，但解答生成应增长得更快，报告的相对倍数约为验证增长的 1.5 至 2 倍。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method represents a solution as a sampled chain of thought and a verification as another generated chain ending in a Yes/No verdict. For each candidate, it averages the probability assigned to Yes across V verifier generations, then uses best-of-N selection. Its simplified cost is proportional to S(1+λV), where λ is the ratio between verification and solution token lengths; self-consistency is the special case V=0 followed by majority voting. This formulation makes the token cost of verification visible in every comparison.

For the fine-tuned generative verifier, the authors first let a solution generator answer MATH training problems and ask GPT-4o to produce verification rationales with access to ground-truth solutions. They retain only rationales whose verdict agrees with the ground-truth correctness of the generated answer and balance Yes and No examples, then fine-tune student LLMs. At inference they vary S and V over increasing ranges, measure success rate against compute, derive optimal S and V for each budget, and fit power laws to those optima.

该方法把解答表示为一条采样得到的思维链，把验证表示为另一条以“是/否”判决结束的生成链。对于每个候选，它在 V 次验证生成中平均分配给“是”的概率，再用最佳 N 次选择。其简化成本与 S(1+λV) 成正比，其中 λ 是验证与解答令牌长度之比；自一致性是 V=0 后做多数投票的特殊情形。这一表述使验证的令牌成本在每一次比较中都可见。

为训练生成式验证器，作者先让解答生成器回答 MATH 训练题，再要求 GPT-4o 在可见标准解答的条件下生成验证理由。他们只保留判决与所生成答案真实正确性一致的理由，并平衡“是”和“否”的样本，随后微调学生语言模型。推理时，作者在不断扩大的范围内改变 S 和 V，测量成功率相对于计算量的变化，为每个预算导出最优 S 和 V，并对这些最优值拟合幂律。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The COLM paper evaluates compute-matched curves on MATH, AIME24, and GPQA-Diamond, with additional model-family and scale checks using Llama and Qwen configurations. It reports that self-consistency is more compute-efficient than generative verification at most practical budgets. In the illustrative MATH setting with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, the generative verifier first matches self-consistency only after up to eight times the inference compute and needs substantially more budget to move ahead.

The paper also reports that at high compute, generative verification can win: one figure describes an additional 128-fold compute increase for a 3.8% gain in the stated comparison. Its difficulty analysis finds harder MATH problems benefit more from the fine-tuned verifier, with up to 30% relative improvement over self-consistency in the reported condition. These results support a conditional policy rather than a blanket verdict: account for verifier quality, problem difficulty, and the actual cost of verification before spending the budget on it.

这篇 COLM 论文在 MATH、AIME24 和 GPQA-Diamond 上评估计算量匹配曲线，并用 Llama 与 Qwen 配置额外检查模型家族和规模。它报告，在多数实际预算下，自一致性比生成式验证更具计算效率。在以 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 为例的 MATH 设置中，生成式验证器最多要消耗八倍推理计算才首次与自一致性持平，并且需要显著更高的预算才会领先。

论文还报告，在高计算量下生成式验证能够获胜：一个图表描述了再增加 128 倍计算，才在所述比较中取得 3.8% 的收益。其难度分析发现，较难的 MATH 问题从微调验证器中获益更多，在报告条件下相对自一致性的提升最高达 30%。这些结果支持的是条件性策略，而非一刀切的结论：在把预算花在验证上之前，应考虑验证器质量、问题难度以及验证的真实成本。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive contribution is not merely using a generative verifier. The paper changes the comparison unit from number of solutions to total inference computation, making a verifier's own chains of thought part of the bill. This corrects a common evaluation shortcut in which a verification method is credited for using fewer candidates while its many expensive verification rollouts are uncounted.

It also treats the two sample counts as jointly optimizable scaling axes. Rather than recommending a fixed number of verifier calls, it derives empirical scaling laws for solution and verification counts and identifies a growth asymmetry favoring solution exploration. The resulting contribution is a decision framework: under a known budget, choose whether verification is worth activating and, if it is, grow solutions more aggressively than verification chains.

其独特贡献不只是使用生成式验证器。论文把比较单位从解答数量改为总推理计算，把验证器自己的思维链也计入成本。这纠正了一种常见的评估捷径：某个验证方法因使用较少候选而被视为高效，但其大量昂贵的验证轨迹却未被计算。

它还把两种采样数量视为可联合优化的扩展轴。论文不是推荐固定的验证调用次数，而是为解答数和验证数导出经验标度律，并识别出偏向解答探索的增长不对称性。由此产生的是一个决策框架：在已知预算下，先选择验证是否值得启用；若值得，则应比验证链更积极地扩大解答数量。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The analysis assumes that a solution and its verification can be costed by generated tokens and, in its simplified formulation, often uses the same model family for both roles. Real serving stacks may have different model sizes, batching, caching, latency targets, and verifier prompts, so the fitted constants and crossover budget will not transfer automatically. The fine-tuned verifier also depends on teacher-generated rationales and known-answer filtering. Results on MATH, AIME, and GPQA do not establish that the same allocation law holds for open-ended tasks where correctness cannot be reduced to a reliable terminal verdict.
分析假定解答和验证可以按生成令牌计费，并且在其简化表述中常让两个角色使用同一模型家族。真实服务栈可能具有不同模型规模、批处理、缓存、延迟目标和验证提示，因此拟合出的常数与交叉预算不会自动迁移。微调验证器还依赖教师生成的理由和已知答案过滤。MATH、AIME 和 GPQA 上的结果并不能证明同一分配规律适用于开放式任务，因为这类任务的正确性无法被归结为可靠的终端判决。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper to design an inference controller that has a budget B and can choose solution count S and verification count V. Log the model and prompt used for each role, token lengths, solution answers, verification rationales, Yes probabilities, aggregation rule, total latency, and success rate by difficulty. These records let a system estimate its own λ and find its own crossover between self-consistency and verification. The official repository is especially useful because it exposes scripts for solution generation, verification generation, success-rate plots, and released model/data resources rather than leaving the budget accounting implicit.
可用这篇论文设计一个拥有预算 B、并能选择解答数量 S 与验证数量 V 的推理控制器。应记录各角色使用的模型和提示、令牌长度、解答答案、验证理由、“是”的概率、聚合规则、总延迟以及按难度划分的成功率。这些记录让系统估计自身的 λ，并找出自一致性和验证之间的交叉点。官方仓库尤其有用，因为它公开了解答生成、验证生成、成功率绘图以及已发布模型/数据资源的脚本，而不是把预算核算隐含起来。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the fixed-budget curves before interpreting a verifier's best-of-N result. Check whether the comparison includes all verification tokens, whether the verifier sees a gold solution during training but not at test time, and how correlated the sampled solutions and verifier verdicts are. For replication, sweep S and V jointly rather than holding one fixed, report the entire success-rate–compute frontier, and stratify by task difficulty. The important deployment question is not whether a verifier can identify a correct solution, but whether doing so beats generating the additional solutions that its verification cost would otherwise have purchased.
在解释验证器的最佳 N 次结果之前，应先阅读固定预算曲线。需要检查比较是否包含全部验证令牌，验证器训练时是否看到了标准解答而测试时没有，以及采样解答与验证器判决之间的相关性有多高。复现时应联合扫描 S 和 V，而不是固定其中一个；应报告完整的成功率—计算量前沿，并按任务难度分层。重要的部署问题不是验证器能否识别正确解答，而是这样做是否优于用同样的验证成本去生成额外解答。
